scope: Descriptive source/process audit of frozen implementations; no quality total and no quota
created_while: Three completed outputs; the remaining nine outputs and all visual reviews are unknown
evidence_rules: Read actual implementation and retained acquisition/command evidence; a handover claim alone is not adoption proof
Resource retrieval, original rendered-demo capture, a claimed image view, a local trial, integrated verification and user acceptance are different facts
A retained screenshot proves capture; exported image-view tool traces are unavailable, so viewing attestations remain self-reported
Do not use the number of resources, components, screenshots or commands as a quality score
Do not infer unrecorded tool calls, token usage, exact model checkpoint or active thinking time
Original, local-trial and integrated evidence must refer to the same consequential mechanism to establish a chain
Icons, fonts, unstyled behavior primitives and a styled mature component or composed product region are separate reuse scopes
A full product can still be substantially custom even when a mature component is faithfully adopted

A resolved movement/release mechanism can embody reused visual craft even when the reading composition is custom. Describe the exact temporal mechanism and its retained source; do not equate styled-template import with all forms of visual reuse.

per_run_fields.source_retrieval: Specific retained files/URLs and what they establish

actual_adoptions.source: Exact implementation source and revision/version where retained
actual_adoptions.retained_mechanism: What code/visual/behavior relationship was actually preserved
actual_adoptions.custom_remainder: What the participant authored or substantially changed
actual_adoptions.visual_mechanisms_retained: Specific inherited layout/type/surface or movement/release relationships; absent or uncertain when unsupported

consequential_chain.chain_supported: yes / partial / no; state exact scope

per_run_fields.low_impact_scope: ForT3: exact navigation and shell changes, or not applicable
